about: What tools/testing/test_check.py lets through, which has to match exactly and should only shrink. component: the old white-box tests, each with what it reaches into; none are added, and each one goes when it's rewritten as a behavioral or unit test. behavior_wraps: behavioral tests that fake something outside us with --wrap because it has no provider yet. behavior_not_given_when_then: behavioral tests not yet written as given, when, then specifications, which tools/testing/spec_check.py lets through.

component.tests/component/akao_irq_component.c: Reaches into the AKAO driver's internal state to check the sound effect volume, fades and reverb.
component.tests/component/akao_noise_opcodes_compo: Runs single AKAO opcodes on the driver's internal channels.
component.tests/component/akao_stream_component.c: Uses the AKAO driver's internals, and wraps lom_native_akao_stream_fail to catch a refused stream.
component.tests/component/spu_completion_component: Reads AKAO's and PSY-Z's internal globals, and wraps PSY-Z's kernel calls.
Calls FIELD's internal functions and tables, and wraps the CD queue.
component.tests/component/field_actor_component.c: Calls FIELD's internal actor functions and tables, and wraps lom_native_rand.
Wraps lom_native_field_fail to catch FIELD stopping on a CD wait.
component.tests/component/field_golem_party_compon: Calls FIELD's internal script operations and tables.
component.tests/component/field_heap_component.c: Calls FIELD's internal functions, and wraps the CD queue.
component.tests/component/field_music_stream_compo: Calls FIELD's internal music stream, and wraps AKAO and lom_native_field_fail.
component.tests/component/field_party_component.c: Calls FIELD's internal functions, and wraps LoadImage and the CD queue.
component.tests/component/field_resources_componen: Calls FIELD's functions by address, and wraps LoadImage and DrawSync.
component.tests/component/field_services_component: Calls FIELD's functions, and wraps akao_upload_bank.
component.tests/component/japanese_balance_compone: Includes src/field/field_japanese_balance.c to reach its static functions.
component.tests/component/movie_audio_output_edges: Includes movie_native.c, and wraps the movie audio queue and malloc to force failures.
component.tests/component/movie_completion_compone: Includes movie_native.c, and wraps the movie decoder's close and frame reads.
component.tests/component/controller_callback_comp: Uses the controller code's internal header, and wraps the port's pad and vertical blank calls.
component.tests/component/controller_multitap_slot: Uses the controller code's internal header.
component.tests/component/controller_rumble_compon: Uses the controller code's internal header, and wraps lom_native_PadSetAct.
component.tests/component/keyboard_controls_compon: Uses the controller code's internal header, and wraps SDL's keyboard calls.
component.tests/component/title_input_component.c: Uses TITLE's internal header, and wraps akao_play_sfx.

tests/behavior/audio_categories_specific.why: Feeds known CD audio samples in; the CD audio has no provider yet.

tests/behavior/cd_audio_matrix_specifica.why: Watches the CD audio mix the port gives PSY-Z; PSY-Z's CD audio has no provider yet.

tests/behavior/movie_audio_output_sdl_sp.why: Stands in for SDL's audio stream to see what the movie audio sends it; SDL audio has no provider yet.

tests/behavior/settings_runtime_specific.why: Presses keys without a keyboard; SDL input has no provider yet.

tests/behavior/settings_store_specificat.why: Makes saving the settings fail; SDL's file calls have no provider yet.
